Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-07-10 21:36 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors proxy global risk appetite and real yield differentials; their strength suggests a "risk-on" environment that typically supports EM currencies like BRL. A -7.4% residual indicates USDBRL is trading significantly below its factor-implied fair value, implying the Real is fundamentally overvalued or experiencing idiosyncratic bullish pressure not captured by global equity styles. This suggests local catalysts or central bank intervention are currently decoupling BRL from broader macro-factor trends.
